sent_bad: 4. **Informed of the right to withdraw (Article 7(3))**: Prior to giving consent, the data subject must be informed that they have the right to withdraw consent at any time, and that withdrawal shall be as easy as giving consent.

6. **Special categories of data (Article 9(2)(a))**: A person may give **explicit** consent to the processing of special categories of personal data (e.g., health data, biometric data) for one or more specified purposes, except where Union or Member State law provides that the prohibition may not be lifted by the data subject.
